messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a microfix deploy tonight in the 23:30 UTC change window. PR #4528 contains a deps pin that fixed flakiness. Intend to bump patch v2.14.5 -> v2.14.6 and roll canary -> 25% -> 100% if green. deploy-bot will run the usual smoke tests.

maria: quick question — do we treat a deps pin as a patch under our semver rules or does pinning transitive deps require a minor because it could change behavior?

jin: our docs say behavioral changes -> minor, otherwise bugfix -> patch. pin only for tests/runtime stability is usually a patch. but if it fixes a user-facing regression, still patch.

alex: small nit: should the tag include buildmeta (`+pin.abc123`) so we can trace the exact lockfile? or put the lockfile hash only in the release notes?

sam: prefer keeping semver clean and add buildmeta in release notes only. tag = v2.14.6, release notes include `lockfile:@abcd123` and the commit SHA. easier to grep.

maria: ok. for release-note format — do we use `fix:` or `chore:`? This is fixing flaky prod tests but not adding features.

jin: use `fix:` — user-facing reliability improvement. `chore:` feels internal.

release-bot: PR #4528 merged by sam at 1719124000. Generated changelog entry:
```
fix(release): pin transitive dep to avoid intermittent indexer flakes
- pin package-x@1.2.3 (reason: flaky indexer in edge cases)
- tests: add repro case + flaky guard

Metadata: lockfile:ab12cd34, commit: d4f5e6a
```

alex: rollback policy reminder — fallback to v2.14.5 if error rate > 4% or latency p95 increases > 150ms for 10m window? ops, confirm thresholds.

ops: confirm. we'll run canary 25% for 15m. auto-rollback triggers:
- 5xx rate delta > 3% absolute and sustained 5m
- p95 latency increase > 150ms sustained 10m
- error budget burn > 20% in 10m
If any trigger hits, deploy-bot will pause and we revert to v2.14.5.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary at 1719126600 UTC. Will post updates to this thread and create a rollback PR if any trigger fires.

maria: thanks. one last ask — add a line in release notes about how to reproduce the flaky test (path + input) so support can triage faster.

sam: good call. I'll add that to the notes and include a short `how to repro` snippet. merging to main in 5. :thumbsup:

jin: LGTM

alex: :+1: good to go.

release-bot: Canary started at 1719126600 — 25% of traffic. Observability dashboards: https://observability.company/release/v2.14.6-canary

deploy-bot: Canary passed 15m checks, moving to 100% at 1719126800.

release-bot: Release v2.14.6 published at 1719126890. Notes include lockfile and commit.

ops: leaving postmortem hooks enabled for 24h. If any regressions show, ping #incidents and tag this thread.
